Auto Skill Trigger - Match skills to tasks using keyword scoring

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of auto-skill-trigger: Auto Skill Trigger - Match skills to tasks using keyword scoring.
- Automatically scores and filters available skills based on message relevance using a simple TF-IDF-like keyword overlap algorithm.
- Only top-matching skills (configurable, default: top 5 above a 0.3 threshold) are considered, streamlining skill selection.
- Supports basic stop word filtering and custom configuration for max skills and threshold.
- Displays skill hints in the prompt to guide further action.
